5.8 cents is cheap power — that's the good end of this. The H15 Dual runs $999 and ships November 14, 2026.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup already running?
first miner, what are the numbers?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

H15 Dual: $999, 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Dogecoin, ~500 W, ~50 dB. At your 5.8¢ that's about 360 kWh a month, roughly $21 in power. Ships November 14, 2026.

For a first miner, the honest comparison: the Harlo B30 is $899 for 30 TH/s at 360–450 W — double the Bitcoin hashrate, less power, about $17 a month at your rate. The H15's extra is the Dogecoin side.

Twice the Bitcoin hashrate means twice the draws at a full block, every ten minutes, for years, and you still own the machine. Do you want the Doge/LTC mining, or is this Bitcoin only?
is this solo only or i can join a pool?

Either. You point it wherever you want — solo at your own node for the full block shot, or a pool like Ocean or Public Pool for small steady payouts straight to your own wallet, no exchange, no KYC. It's a setting in the miner's web page, and you can switch any time.

Most first-time buyers start on a pool to see sats arrive, then try solo.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
